_README: GitHub webhook -> native graph record admission (aegis-c01c.3, docs/design/github-ingress.md). Governed DATA: admitting an event or an action is a reviewed edit here. 'events' keys are X-GitHub-Event names; 'actions' lists the admitted payload actions (push has none); 'class' is the subject entity's class; 'object' is the payload key holding the subject; 'thread' is the payload key holding the pull request or issue a review or comment belongs to. Every admitted <event>.<action> must also be in GitHubActivityShape's githubEventKind sh:in list (tests/test_github_ingress.py holds the two together). An event or action not listed is QUARANTINED with its reason, never dropped and never guessed; 'ping' is acknowledged and writes nothing. 'events_api' maps the poller's Events API types onto webhook event names, and renames the actions the Events API spells differently. The sha256 of this file rides in every episode's source.
